name: XPR-LinPrim Culling
definition: A culling method for point-based rendering that uses a global primitive-level bound on chord length to determine if a primitive can be discarded for a tile, eliminating the need for a separate per-pixel opacity test.
summary: XPR-LinPrim Culling is a primitive-level early discard method for point-based volume rendering that uses a global bound on the maximum ray chord length through a primitive to determine if it can be discarded for an entire tile.
